programme_name: Lineage repeatability of phylogenetic trait memory

relationship_to_prior_studies.new_question: Does family identity explain a repeatable component of memory-loss rate across different traits after trait-specific means are controlled?
relationship_to_prior_studies.prohibited_reinterpretation: Do not compare family variance against trait variance; the prior variance-ratio question remains terminal HOLD.

admission_set.source: frozen 201-system crossed core from workflow run 37086693588 / artifact 11263253304
admission_set.reuse_rule: Use this outcome-blind final core exactly. Do not add or remove systems based on real rho.

response.estimator: memory_loss_rho = Spearman(all unordered S3 patristic distances, absolute species-state differences)
response.species_state: median valid BIEN measurement per species
response.interpretation: larger positive rho means faster loss of trait similarity with phylogenetic separation

primary_model.trait_role: fixed nuisance effect; each admitted trait gets its own mean
primary_model.family_role: random intercept representing a lineage-wide shift shared across multiple traits
primary_model.rationale: The parameter asks whether family identity is repeatable across traits after all trait-specific mean memory rates are removed. It does not compare family variance with between-trait variance.

practical_reference.note: The 10% threshold is frozen before real rho is opened and is not used for system selection.

model_informativeness_gate.trait_fixed_effects: 12 deterministic centered means equally spaced from -0.10 to +0.10 and assigned by sorted trait name; these are simulation-only nuisance means
model_informativeness_gate.failure_rule: If either benchmark fails, stop before opening real rho; do not change the core, benchmark, threshold or model.

bootstrap.simulation: parametric bootstrap from fitted trait fixed effects, family random intercept variance, and residual variance
bootstrap.confidence_interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of finite conditional family repeatability

real_analysis_if_gate_passes.prune_only_sensitivity: Repeat the identical model on prune-only rho for the identical 201 systems; descriptive mandatory sensitivity only.
real_analysis_if_gate_passes.leave_one_trait_out: Refit primary S3 model after removing each trait in turn; descriptive robustness only.
real_analysis_if_gate_passes.leave_one_family_out: Refit primary S3 model after removing each family in turn; descriptive robustness only.

hard_nonclaims: No claim that family effects dominate trait effects.
No use of systems outside the frozen 201-edge core.
No source or threshold rescue after real rho is opened.
